clues: This city sits on the east shore of a wide bay, on a large island in the west Pacific. A river runs through its middle and splits it in two.
This tropic city has a dry spell, then a long wet spell. In the wet months rain falls in short, heavy bursts, and typhoons come too.
Spain's men took this shore in 1571 and built a walled fort town. The town then served as the capital for Spain's isles in the east.
A walled old town still stands by the bay in this city. Spanish builders raised its thick walls long ago, on the ruins of an older town.
This city is the heart of the Philippines. Its districts send members to Congress for the whole land.
